name: playtest_raymarch
description: Not a test — the install step for a hands-on session with §25c's RAYMARCHED cloud volume switched on, run with --hold so the game is handed over rather than quit. cloud_volume_shader is pinned at 1 because every failure in the §25c load path degrades to §25b's baked atlas on purpose: without the pin, a session where the AssetBundle failed to load would hand over a perfectly playable game drawing the wrong renderer, and nothing would say so. Roll the install back afterwards with run_test.sh --recover-only.
